headline: Brazilian DI Interest Rates Rise Amid Fiscal Policy Concerns
summary: Brazilian DI interest rate futures advanced amid market concerns regarding the new government's economic agenda and fiscal proposals.
why: DI interest rate futures reflect market expectations for Brazil's benchmark Selic rate, impacting borrowing costs across the economy.

impacts.name: Brazilian DI interest rate
impacts.why: Fiscal concerns push up local interest rate futures as investors demand higher yields.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Rising apprehension over fiscal policy and government spending plans drove up DI interest rates.
